papers.title: The Lexical Imprint of Pre-training Data
papers.summary: Pre-training corpora leave a lexical imprint on zero-shot accuracy that is consistently tracked by word-level unigram cross-entropy across benchmarks, document selection, and prompt routing.

papers.title: Zooming without Zooming v2: From Seeing Details to Connecting Evidence for Generalizable Multimodal Perception
papers.summary: EvidenceConnect synthesizes training data to strengthen visual evidence connection, improving spatial perception and multimodal reasoning across diverse tasks.

papers.title: Can Discrete Tokens Serve as Semantically Lossless Representations of Visual Signals?
papers.summary: Factorized Vector Quantization improves discrete visual token quality by using parallel codebooks on complementary feature views, enabling discrete representations to match continuous ones in multimodal understanding.

papers.title: Truncate or Not? A Scaling Study of Looped Transformers with Truncated Backpropagation
papers.summary: Looped transformers trained with full backpropagation through time outperform truncated alternatives under matched compute, with scaling laws identifying two loops as optimal when model size is adjustable.

papers.title: Rare, Relevant, and Still Wrong: How Memory Fails LLM Group Decisions
papers.summary: When compressing multi-agent discussions for final decisions, memory selection by rarity or relevance both fail due to decoy inclusion and social-proof bias, and even full transcripts reduce accuracy compared to no notes.
